$[A]_t = [A]_0 e^{-kt}$

$\frac{1}{2} = e^{-k \cdot 30}$

$[A]_{60} = [A]_0 e^{-k \cdot 60}$

$[A]_{60} = [A]_0 e^{-\ln(4)} = [A]_0 \cdot \frac{1}{4}$

So, after 60 minutes, one-fourth of the original azomethane remains.
